channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Separate persons become a collective organized by a place, a center, a front, and a directing authority.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Spatial precedence at the middle and front scales into social precedence, including lordship and the chief of sailors.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: A chief of sailors presides while a whole is divided and distinguished into portions.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Roots used on the surface for running, gathering, and entering the middle become the roles of foe, ally, claimant, and mediator.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Relations between parties are bound as pacts, opposed as enmity, argued through claims, and restored through judgment or mediation.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Roots used on the surface for running, gathering, and entering the middle become the roles of foe, ally, claimant, and mediator.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Relations between parties are bound as pacts, opposed as enmity, argued through claims, and restored through judgment or mediation.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Roots used on the surface for running, gathering, and entering the middle become the roles of foe, ally, claimant, and mediator.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: An intermediary enters between opposed sides and works toward renewed agreement.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Opposition supplies the two sides, the mediator occupies the relational middle, and alliance or covenant supplies the sought outcome.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: lordship or mastery (`ر ب ب:B001/m01`); gradual nurture (`ر ب ب:B002/m01`); generosity or gift (`خ ي ر:B005/m01`); provision and repair (`غ ي ر:B001/m01`); ingratitude and withholding (`ك ن د:B002/m01`)
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Benefaction and Broken Return
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: A valued good draws attachment and choice, while generosity and nurture create an obligation that can be answered or denied.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Moral good expands into concrete gift, provision, watering, and care, while ingratitude is figured as withholding and severance.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: A lord or caretaker grants provision and nurture, but the recipient withholds acknowledgment and severs the expected return.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Mastery and nurture define the benefactor's role, gift and provision define what moves toward the recipient, and ingratitude reverses the relation by withholding its expected acknowledgment.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: tightened bond (`ش د د:B001/m01`); firm knot (`ر ب ب:B016/m01`); hand-and-neck shackle (`ج م ع:B008/m01`)
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Knot, Bond, and Shackle
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Material wholes are bound, cut, inverted, scattered, and gathered into a new result.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: The eschatological scattering and collection sequence also yields a concrete mechanics of knots, shackles, fractures, and inverted basins.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Separate parts are tightened into a durable knot and restraint closes hands or limbs against movement.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Tightening is the operation, the knot is its stable structure, and the shackle applies that structure to bodily restraint.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Places are differentiated by hardness, level, edge, middle, facing, and the capacity to hold a body in position.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Valley banks and hard ground scale into a human-facing side, an opposite side beyond a barrier, and a body or cloud that remains fixed in place.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: A traveler or animal moves across a terrain gradient from soft depression through level clay to hard uneven and barren ground.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Softness and depression describe receptive ground, the plain removes vertical obstruction, hardness introduces resistance, and barrenness names the land's failed productive outcome.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: staying or enduring (`ر ب ب:B007/m01`); disabled camel remaining in place (`ح ب ب:B005/m01`); camel lingering at its morning rest (`ص ب ح:B008/m01`); hard unsettled ground (`ع د و:B010/m01`)
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Residence and Immobilized Animal
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Places are differentiated by hardness, level, edge, middle, facing, and the capacity to hold a body in position.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Valley banks and hard ground scale into a human-facing side, an opposite side beyond a barrier, and a body or cloud that remains fixed in place.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: A body remains at a place through duration, routine, exhaustion, illness, or difficult ground.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Staying supplies the durable state, the two camel motifs distinguish incapacity from routine delay, and difficult ground supplies a setting that reinforces immobility.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: bypass or exception (`ع د و:B004/m01`); otherness or exclusion (`غ ي ر:B005/m01`); quantifying particle (`ر ب ب:B015/m01`); totalized collectivity (`ج م ع:B009/m02`)
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Otherness, Exception, and Quantification
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Language locates referents, excludes alternatives, quantifies occurrence, and derives states or outcomes from a source.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Physical otherness, possession, front, source, and gathered remainder become operations of reference, exception, derivation, and result.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: A statement sets an item apart from a class, marks it as other, and qualifies the frequency or quantity of what remains.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Exception removes an item from the asserted field, otherness names the contrast, totality defines the larger set, and the particle modulates how often or how many instances are asserted.

concept_map.definition: Bir şey hakkında bilgi edinme veya edinilen bilgiyi başkasına iletme; ayrıca sorarak öğrenme, sınama ve deneyim yoluyla bir işin iç yüzünü tanıma alanıdır. Bir kimsenin ya da şeyin dış görünüşünden ayrılan gerçek niteliği de bu bilgi alanının uzantısı olarak belirtir.

concept_gloss.applicability: Yer bağlılığı ile kesintisiz devamın ortak çekirdeğini anlatan genel bağlamlarda uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Hareket etmeme ve bir yerde kalma yönünü korur.

concept_gloss.applicability: Bulutun parçalı, üst üste binmiş veya aşağıda asılı yapısını anlatan genel karşılıktır.

facets.statement: Bulut parçaları üst üste binmiş veya aşağıda asılı duran belirgin bir küme oluşturur.
Beyazlık bazı tanıklıklarda öne çıkar, ancak renk bütün kullanımlar için sabit değildir.
Bitkiyi besleyen yağmurla ilişkilendirilmesi adlandırmanın açıklaması olarak verilir.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bulut parçalarının birbirine binerek bir küme oluşturduğu görünüm için uygundur.

error_profile.adds: Yağmur taşıma zorunluluğu ekler ve katmanlı ya da asılı yapı sınırını belirsizleştirir.
error_profile.collision: Her yağmur bulutunun bu özel yapıda olduğu izlenimini doğurur.
error_profile.preserves: Bulut ve yağışla ilişki yönünü korur.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kanıt, birbirine binmiş ya da aşağıda asılı duran bir bulut kümesini ortak kimlik olarak destekler. Beyazlık bazı tanıklıklarda belirtilse de başka tanıklıklar siyah olabileceğini söylediğinden renk tanımın zorunlu öğesi değildir.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar değerlendirildi; bulut türleri arasında yapısal sınırı en açık gösteren aday seçildi, doğrudan yağmur veya mevsimsel yağış bildiren adaylar dışarıda bırakıldı.

neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal yapısal katmanlaşma ve asılı konumla tanımlanır; komşu dal ise su taşıma, koyu renk ve göksel işaret ilişkisini öne çıkarır.

neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal da belirgin ve yoğun bir bulut oluşumunu gösterebilir.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kanıt, yakın zamanda gerçekleşmişlik, tazelik ve başlangıç evresi çekirdeğini destekler. Yeni doğurmuş ve süt için evde tutulan koyun özel bir uygulama, gençliğin başlangıcı ise insan yaşamına taşınmış bir kullanımdır.

error_profile.preserves: Kişilerin aynı bağlayıcı söz çevresinde birleşmesini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Vergi veya onda bir payın sözleşmeye benzer bağlayıcılıkla adlandırıldığı özel kullanım içindir.

facets.statement: İşlemde anaparanın üstüne bir fazlalık eklenir.
Borç verenin verdiğinden daha çoğunu geri alması belirgin bir gerçekleşmedir.
Fazlalığın anlamı ve hükmü, alışveriş veya borcun belirli kuruluş biçimine bağlıdır.
Kişinin bu tür fazlalık içeren bir işleme girmesi ayrıca anlatılabilir.

hermeticity.limitations: This is a reconstructed hermetic trace because focus and context arrived together in one sealed packet, not a strict staged discovery log. I used no target, gold reading, prior output, tafsir, or source outside the packet, prompt, and response schema; causal arrows below are reader inferences rather than packet assertions.
hermeticity.method: I first built focus-only models from 100:11 and its two supplied branch inventories, then tested the context_root_cues in packet order for changes that remained anchored in رَبَّهُم, بِهِمْ, يَوْمَئِذٍ, or خَبِير.

remaining_uncertainties: The hierarchy among شهيد, يعلم, and خبير is inferred from sequence and branch contrast; the packet does not itself declare a hierarchy or settle every pronoun antecedent.
The singular بِهِۦ to plural بِهِمْ reversal is structurally suggestive but does not prove that effects and agents are intentionally contrasted.
Agricultural, somatic, hydraulic, quiver, and covenant-surplus models depend on branch-distant analogy; they remain live activations, not lexical disambiguations.
يَوْمَئِذٍ can mark manifestation without implying newly acquired knowledge, but the temporal construction alone does not force that distinction.
strongest_changes: The final خبير becomes the endpoint of a forensic chain in which hidden causes emit recoverable signs, yet the Lord's knowledge reaches beyond signs to the persons behind them.
The رب relation changes from bare authority to a history of nurture confronted by cutting, ingratitude, and barrenness; the final possessive says that failed reciprocity does not erase the relation.
شهيد, يعلم, and خبير form coexisting epistemic modes: presence/testimony, event-triggered disclosure, and tested inward acquaintance.
The grave/chest parallel performs a double excavation of outer person and inner source, while بِهِمْ recomposes both as a whole object of knowledge.
An exploratory cultivation arc survives: nurture, barren ground or viable seed, extraction of kernel or residue, and knowledge of the resulting yield.

reader_b.activated_readings_md:
1. **Nurturing owner as tested knower.** Evidence: ر ب ب B001 lordship/ownership and B002 nurture/completion; خ ب ر B001 report, inquiry, tested inner knowledge. reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Authority joined to tested inner knowledge.** `ر ب ب B001` supplies lordship, ownership, and authority, while `خ ب ر B001` supplies tested knowledge of an affair's inward reality rather than outward appearance. The emphatic clause and repeated human pronouns place that knowledge directly upon the people after graves and breasts have been opened. Authority is the relation; inward expertise is the mode of oversight. The packet supplies both roles; I infer that competent authority encompasses the disclosed inner account. `لَّخَبِيرٌ` reads as penetrating, tested knowledge appropriate to lordship, not knowledge by distant report.

2. **Nurture makes the knowledge longitudinal and relational.** `ر ب ب B002` supplies stage-by-stage nurture, repair, and completion. Joined to `خ ب ر B001`, it creates knowledge acquired through sustained care of the same subjects, while 100:6-8 show their ingratitude and redirected attachment. The nurturer's continued relation supplies the basis for knowing development and response over time. The packet does not state that care causes acquaintance; that is my abductive arrow. The final predicate can therefore read as intimate knowledge of a nurtured history, not a new discovery made only `يَوْمَئِذٍ`.

3. **Exploratory cultivation and harvest reading.** `خ ب ر B003` includes the expert cultivator or sharecropper, and `ر ب ب B002` supplies nurture. In the same fixed window, `ك ن د B003` gives barren land, `ح ب ب B001` seed, `خ ي ر B005` beneficence, and `ح ص ل B001`, `B002`, and `B003` the resolved yield, extracted value, or residue. These branches form cultivator, ground, seed or gift, and harvest-account. The packet supplies the complete ecological inventory; I infer that it models the human response to nurture. On this coexisting reading, `رَبَّهُم ... لَّخَبِيرٌ` is the expert cultivator who already knows the ground and accurately assesses what its inward crop has yielded.

words.gloss_range: on that Day, a temporal adverb with backward-pointing reference to the immediately prior resurrection and disclosure events
words.prose: {{ar:يَوْمَئِذٍۢ}} ({{tr:yawmaʾidhin}}) is an accusative temporal adverb, not a new subject or object. Its deictic second element points back to the known when of 100:9-10, and its compensatory nunation carries the omitted clause into the final assertion: the Day is the time when graves are overturned and what is in breasts is brought out. The attachment can be heard as modifying the predicate specifically or the whole emphatic clause, so the safest reading is that the phrase locates the manifestation of the final claim rather than limiting divine knowledge to that moment. Placed after {{ar:بِهِمْ}} ({{tr:bihim}}) and before {{ar:لَّ خَبِيرٌۢ}} ({{tr:la-khabīrun}}), it pivots from the known human object to the emphatic attribute. The Day-language also brushes against the disclosure-news field of 99:4, where hidden information becomes reportable, while the local role remains this ayah's temporal disclosure marker. Its final nunation also links audibly with {{ar:خَبِيرٌۢ}} ({{tr:khabīrun}}), binding disclosure-time and knowledge in the closing cadence.

words.gloss_range: emphatic predicate prefix that marks the delayed knowledge predicate as the landing point of the clause
words.prose: {{ar:لَّ}} ({{tr:la}}) is the predicate prefix: it attaches to {{ar:خَبِيرٌۢ}} ({{tr:khabīrun}}), not to the subject, object phrase, or time phrase. It supplies the second half of the {{ar:إِنَّ}} ({{tr:inna}}) ... {{ar:لَّ خَبِيرٌۢ}} ({{tr:la-khabīrun}}) emphatic envelope, so the clause closes with certainty focused on the attribute; a reported form without this prefix would still assert, but it would lose this second certainty layer. Because it is fused into the predicate, assertion and predicate arrive as one recited unit after {{ar:يَوْمَئِذٍۢ}} ({{tr:yawmaʾidhin}}). The same surah has already used an emphatic predicate prefix in 100:6, 100:7, and 100:8, so this final prefix makes the divine attribute the last landing point in a local chain of emphatic predicates.

words.gloss_range: intensive predicate of penetrating, tested knowledge concerning them, emphatically asserted at the surah's close
words.prose: {{ar:خَبِيرٌۢ}} ({{tr:khabīrun}}) is the nominative predicate of the emphatic clause, and the whole sentence resolves into it: {{ar:رَبَّهُم}} ({{tr:rabbahum}}) supplies the subject, {{ar:بِهِمْ}} ({{tr:bihim}}) the domain, and {{ar:يَوْمَئِذٍۢ}} ({{tr:yawmaʾidhin}}) the disclosure-time. The intensive adjective on {{ar:خ ب ر}} ({{tr:kh-b-r}}), reinforced by {{ar:لَّ}} ({{tr:la}}), makes the close rest on an enduring attribute of penetrating expertise rather than a momentary act of noticing. The root family includes informing, reporting, testing, and probing, and here that field is narrowed to knowledge that reaches hidden interiors, matching 100:10 where what is in the breasts is brought out. Because the word is also the predicate slot of the sentence, the reporting side of the root-field turns the clause's own delivered news into its final attribute. As the last word of the surah, it turns the exposure events into an explanatory seal: the upheaval does not have the last word; the Lord's penetrating knowledge does. Its relation to the time word and the local emphatic predicate chain also lets the close answer earlier human predicates in 100:6, 100:7, and 100:8 with divine knowledge.
